Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Singleton
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/29/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 279 as introduced provides for 1) the general election of the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court and the presiding judges of the appellate courts; 2) the staggard election of associate justices of the Supreme Court and judges of the appellate courts by district, beginning with the 2024 general election and; 3) provides that the districts shall be the same districts as the State Board of Education districts.
This could increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State by an undetermined amount to comply with the provisions of this bill.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
